semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in ozone generators and systems specifically designed for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Qingdao Guolin Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and maintains ozone generators and ozone water systems tailored for the semiconductor sector. Their products are aimed at enhancing cleaning and processing applications within semiconductor fabrication and assembly.
capabilities: Ozone water systems for semiconductor applications

regional_presence.China: The company operates as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Qingdao Guolin Technology Group Co., Ltd., indicating a strong presence in China.
